target: R-minus strict gain or stronger unrestricted entropy inequality
finding: For every q8 graph-FD law, varying triangle-syndrome factors must cover all ten graph vertices; more generally Delta is bounded by the sum of causal syndrome uncertainties outside any factor block omitting a vertex. Thus at least four syndrome bits must vary for a weighted strict law, and all reweightings of one- and two-outlier examples with only factors 1,2 varying are ruled out. Every affine syndrome subspace of dimension <=3 has q8 FD cardinality <=2^20, independently checked over all 6,347,715 three-subspaces.
blocker: No strict positive-gap FD law or improved numerical global bound. Six representative minimal-cover uniform and weighted MIP searches reached time limits, with no strict incumbent; the finite-q cardinality hyperplane gate already excludes uniform gain whenever one of six distinguished syndromes is fixed, but does not exclude arbitrary weighted laws. All written results await scientific review.
next_action: Seek weighted strict laws on covering syndrome supports or sharper nonlinear inequalities; integrate any assigned review first.
